comparison.objective: Candidate locks an adjustable gripper stop; PR-1868 mates and locks a hose quick-connect fitting.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires coaxial driver seating plus wrench countertorque; PR-1868 requires fitting alignment, insertion, and collar/pawl engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate verifies repeated angular return; PR-1868 verifies seating, collar-forward locking, release clearance, and pull retention.
comparison.reason: Both involve retention, but one tests preserving a screw setting during jam-nut tightening and the other tests connector insertion and latch engagement.
